title: cannot read SSL certificate error on fedora rawhide
body:
The latest update seem to have broken the `requests` module which blocks packit to even function. Maybe wait a little for rawhide to update or try moving the required later versions of packages into a venv, difficult to properly setup in the container although.
Error

``` Traceback (most recent call last): File "/usr/bin/packit", line 5, in from packit.cli.packit_base import packit_base File "/usr/lib/python3.14/site-packages/packit/cli/packit_base.py", line 9, in from packit.cli.build import build File "/usr/lib/python3.14/site-packages/packit/cli/build.py", line 10, in from packit.cli.builds.copr_build import copr File "/usr/lib/python3.14/site-packages/packit/cli/builds/copr_build.py", line 10, in from packit.cli.types import LocalProjectParameter File "/usr/lib/python3.14/site-packages/packit/cli/types.py", line 11, in from packit.local_project import CALCULATE, LocalProject, LocalProjectBuilder File "/usr/lib/python3.14/site-packages/packit/local_project.py", line 14, in from ogr import GitlabService File "/usr/lib/python3.14/site-packages/ogr/__init__.py", line 11, in from ogr.abstract import AuthMethod File "/usr/lib/python3.14/site-packages/ogr/abstract.py", line 18, in import github File "/usr/lib/python3.14/site-packages/github/__init__.py", line 54, in from . import Auth File "/usr/lib/python3.14/site-packages/github/Auth.py", line 38, in from requests import utils File "/usr/lib/python3.14/site-packages/requests/__init__.py", line 164, in from .api import delete, get, head, options, patch, post, put, request File "/usr/lib/python3.14/site-packages/requests/api.py", line 11, in from . import sessions File "/usr/lib/python3.14/site-packages/requests/sessions.py", line 15, in from .adapters import HTTPAdapter File "/usr/lib/python3.14/site-packages/requests/adapters.py", line 81, in _preloaded_ssl_context.load_verify_locations( ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^ extract_zipped_paths(DEFAULT_CA_BUNDLE_PATH) ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ ) ^ ssl.SSLError: [X509: NO_CERTIFICATE_OR_CRL_FOUND] no certificate or crl found (_ssl.c:4396) ```
